::: {.lead}
`geoscales` organizes the spatial dimension of model data: build nested
region hierarchies over weighted atoms — including geoframes that
cross-cut one another, since every conversion routes through the atom
layer — keep your tables as tables while they gain spatial structure,
convert values between region systems with conserved totals, sample
sub-territories, and see every level of a hierarchy at once. The R
implementation is active; a C++ core and Python bindings are in
development.
:::
